description: INITIALIZE of an identifier-1 whose data description, or the description of an item subordinate to it, contains the DEPENDING phrase of the OCCURS clause - a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction. §1985:VI.6.17.3 SR4: "The description of the data item referenced by identifier-1 or any items subordinate to identifier-1 may not contain the DEPENDING phrase of the OCCURS clause." The ISO/IEC 1989:2002 syntax rules of INITIALIZE (14.8.19.2) carry no such rule, nor does §2023:14.9.20.3 (kb/Work PB5088). Gated in ONE place, InitializeBinder.GateCobol85VariableOccurrence, once per identifier-1 after it resolves; an item the reference does not resolve is refused by its own rule and is not asked.
display: INITIALIZE of an item with or containing an OCCURS DEPENDING ON clause
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.52 (e) - INITIALIZE of a variable-occurrence item, a COBOL-85 restriction the 2002 syntax rules lift
